top_signals.title: Strait of Hormuz shipping grinds to a halt ahead of U.S.-Iran ceasefire expiry
top_signals.summary: Shipping traffic in the Strait of Hormuz sank to a new low as a ceasefire between the U.S. and Iran is set to expire on Monday with no deal in sight.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Indian Oil Giant Secures U.S. License to Return to Venezuela
top_signals.summary: India’s Oil and Natural Gas Corporation has secured a license from the U.S. Office of Foreign Assets Control to return to Venezuela, Indian media have reported. India’s largest oil and gas company has a 40% stake in the San Cristobal oil project and an 11% stake in the Carabobo project but was forced to curb activity significantly amid a barrage of U.S. sanctions on the South American country. ONGC’s return to Venezuela could open up access to over $500 million in outstanding dividends from its stakes in the two oil projects.…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Chinese Steel Output Tumbles as Economic Conditions Worsen
top_signals.summary: Chinese steel production tumbled last month, putting the industry on track for the lowest annual total this decade as mills adjust to much weaker demand.
